recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is for FHIR-16833. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for this issue unless a future work group decision revisits how alternate expression languages should be represented.
issue_request: FHIR-16833 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CQI change request for FHIR-core Measure. It objected that Measure criteria appeared CQL-only and asked to use the dynamic-language pattern with a language indication; the accepted resolution was to update Measure criteria to the new Expression data type, specifically criteria 1..1 Expression instead of string.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in SVN 14046, represented in git by e169985949ad77cfed6c6e86ee8036a90f98136e. That commit message cites GF#16833 and GF#16783 and the visible patch updates Measure examples from old string/path criteria forms to Expression-shaped criteria with language and expression children. Later source refactoring carries the active Measure definition in source/measure/structuredefinition-Measure.xml.
additional_context: Measure is in current build scope through source/fhir.ini's active resources entry. Current Measure population, stratifier, stratifier component, and supplementalData criteria are typed as Expression. FHIR-16783 is the same historical change family and is already represented on the combined branch by an empty no-change audit commit. Later FHIR-29815 considered multiple languages for criteria and resolved to use cqf-alternativeExpression on Expression rather than changing criteria cardinalities, which matches the current source comments.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The active Measure source already implements the requested Expression datatype and language-bearing expression pattern, and current Measure XML examples no longer retain the old single-attribute criteria value pattern.

related_jiras.note: Same SVN 14046/git e169985949 application updated Measure criteria to Expression; already audited on the combined branch.

Broader clinical reasoning dynamic-language issue resolved to update relevant resources to use the new Expression datatype.
